title: High-Protein Strawberry Cheesecake Ice Cream | Creamy & Easy #easyrecipe
description:
This high-protein strawberry cheesecake ice cream is creamy, sweet, and packed with fresh strawberry flavor in every scoop. Made with simple ingredients, it combines smooth cottage cheese, juicy strawberries, and crunchy graham crackers for a frozen dessert that tastes just like strawberry cheesecake.

The cottage cheese blends into a rich, creamy base while maple syrup adds natural sweetness. Fresh strawberries bring bright, fruity flavor, and crushed graham crackers create the perfect cheesecake-inspired crunch throughout every bite.

This easy no-churn recipe is perfect for summer desserts, healthy sweet cravings, meal prep treats, or whenever you want a protein-packed ice cream without an ice cream machine.

Ingredients
2 cups full-fat cottage cheese
1/4 cup maple syrup
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 cup fresh strawberries, chopped
1/2 cup crushed graham crackers

Optional
Extra strawberries
Extra crushed graham crackers

Instructions
Blend the cottage cheese, maple syrup, vanilla, and 1/2 cup of the strawberries until smooth and creamy.
Stir in the remaining strawberries and the crushed graham crackers.
Pour into a container or loaf pan.
Freeze for 2–3 hours, or until scoopable.
Let sit at room temperature for 5–10 minutes before scooping.
Top with extra strawberries or graham crackers if desired.
Enjoy.

Quick Tip
Letting the ice cream soften for a few minutes before scooping gives it the creamiest texture.

This strawberry cheesecake ice cream is creamy, refreshing, and packed with fresh strawberry flavor in every scoop.

Simple ingredients, fresh strawberry flavor, and a texture that comes out creamy, smooth, and perfectly scoopable every time.
